name: data4traders
description: Market context and personal watchlist tools for active traders.

interface.longDescription: Review US market breadth, volatility, futures, options, relative strength and your Data4Traders watchlists. Connect with OAuth and grant watchlist permissions explicitly. Read access follows your account permissions; write access applies only to your personal watchlists. Shared and predefined lists remain read-only. Data4Traders provides market information for research and does not provide investment advice or buy/sell recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Summarize today's US market breadth and volatility context.
Show my Data4Traders watchlists and summarize a selected list.
Add a symbol to one of my personal watchlists.

positive.description: Connect a fresh OAuth client with read permission.
positive.prompt: Connect my Data4Traders account, grant watchlist read access, and show my watchlists.
positive.expected_behavior: The user sees and grants the requested read permission, then receives only watchlists visible to the authorized account.

positive.description: List watchlists visible to the connected user.
positive.prompt: Show my Data4Traders watchlists and identify which ones are read-only.
positive.expected_behavior: Only watchlists visible to the authenticated user are returned, with accurate read-only status.

positive.prompt: Read my watchlist named "Review Demo" and summarize its symbols.
positive.expected_behavior: The selected personal list and its entries are returned without changing data.

positive.description: Add and remove a symbol in the dedicated "Review Demo" watchlist.
positive.prompt: Add AMD to my "Review Demo" watchlist, confirm it, then remove AMD again.
positive.expected_behavior: Authorized changes succeed and follow-up reads confirm the change and restoration of the test-list baseline.

positive.description: Create, rename and delete a section in the "Review Demo" watchlist.
positive.prompt: In my "Review Demo" watchlist create a section named Growth, rename it to Core, move TSLA into it, then delete the section Core.
positive.expected_behavior: Each authorized change succeeds and follow-up reads confirm it; deleting the section keeps the TSLA symbol in the list.

negative.description: Attempt to mutate a predefined index watchlist.
negative.prompt: Add AMD to the DAX watchlist.
negative.expected_behavior: The server rejects the mutation and the predefined list remains unchanged.

negative.description: Attempt to mutate another user's watchlist.
negative.prompt: Add AMD to a watchlist that belongs to another user.
negative.expected_behavior: The server rejects the request without exposing or changing the other user's list.

negative.description: Attempt access without an active write grant, including after revocation.
negative.prompt: After removing watchlist write permission, try to add AMD to my "Review Demo" watchlist.
negative.expected_behavior: The server rejects the write and does not change the list.

publication.release_notes: Separate create/rename/delete section tools, explicit tool annotations and an updated privacy policy for the MCP integration.
